evals.prompt: Build one camera that chase logic, pointer input, cutscenes, and collision all mutate directly. Smooth position and Euler angles with a fixed per-frame lerp, keep the same near and far planes for every mode, and preserve temporal history through teleports and hard cuts.
evals.expected_output: A stateful camera rig with explicit intent and final transforms, stable coordinate frames, frame-rate-independent damping, quaternion handoffs, bounded collision correction, precision-aware projection, cut resets, and lifecycle tests.
assertions: Camera modes, subject and world frames, composition targets, input ownership, obstacles, projection rules, and comfort limits are mapped.
Desired position, aim, up, FOV, and clipping remain separate from the final smoothed camera transform.
Damping uses time-based units and arbitrary orientation transitions use quaternions rather than Euler-component interpolation.
Teleports, origin shifts, mode changes, and hard cuts reset smoothing, velocity, motion vectors, and temporal post-processing history.
Collision, visibility, fast motion, vertical travel, resize, extreme coordinates, teardown, and fixed-path captures are verified.
